Class SocketVirtualServer

java.lang.Object
network.client.socket.SocketVirtualServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer, ServerMessageVisitor
public class SocketVirtualServer extends Object implements VirtualServer, ServerMessageVisitor
Socket implementation of VirtualServer proxy.

Lifecycle:

  1. SocketVirtualServer(String, int) opens the TCP socket and the Object{Input,Output}Streams. No game-layer wiring happens here.
  2. tryRegisterName(String, LocalGameState, ClientStateListener) performs the name handshake. Reusable across rejections.
  3. start() spawns the reader thread and the bidirectional liveness sentinel.

    • SEND_INTERVAL_MS

      private static final long SEND_INTERVAL_MS
      Client-side socket liveness intervals (milliseconds). Invariant: TIMEOUT_MS > 2 * SEND_INTERVAL_MS, to tolerate scheduling jitter and brief delays from large application messages occupying the sender. Worst-case detection time is TIMEOUT_MS + CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 20 s.

    • SocketVirtualServer

      public SocketVirtualServer(String host, int port) throws IOException
      Opens the TCP socket and the object streams to the server. Performs blocking network I/O, so it must not run on the JavaFX Application Thread.
      Parameters:
      host - the server hostname or IP
      port - the server TCP port
      Throws:
      IOException - if the connection or stream setup fails

  • Method Details

    • tryRegisterName

      public boolean tryRegisterName(String name, LocalGameState localState, ClientStateListener listener)
      Socket name handshake: sends a ConnectMessage and blocks reading the server's reply (bounded by a 50000 ms socket timeout), then dispatches it through this visitor to set the verdict. The TCP connection stays open on rejection, so it can be retried with a different name on the same instance.
      Specified by:
      tryRegisterName in interface VirtualServer
      Parameters:
      name - the requested player name
      localState - the local state to be updated from server snapshots
      listener - the listener notified of inbound server events
      Returns:
      true if the server accepted the name and registered the player; false if the name was already taken (caller may retry with a different name).
